DATA_PACK_MISSING.title: Crafting data is missing
DATA_PACK_MISSING.detail: The bundled data pack could not be found. Reinstall the application.

DATA_PACK_INTEGRITY_FAILED.title: Crafting data is damaged
DATA_PACK_INTEGRITY_FAILED.detail: The bundled data pack failed its integrity check.

DATA_PACK_NOT_VALIDATED.title: Crafting data is not validated
DATA_PACK_NOT_VALIDATED.detail: The bundled data pack did not pass validation, so no results are shown.

DATA_PACK_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED.title: Unsupported data format
DATA_PACK_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED.detail: The bundled data pack uses a format this version cannot read.

DATA_CONFLICT.title: Data conflict
DATA_CONFLICT.detail: The crafting data is inconsistent, so the overlay will not calculate a pool.

GAME_TERM_FALLBACK_EN.title: English term shown
GAME_TERM_FALLBACK_EN.detail: No official translation is available for {{entityId}}; the English name is shown.

NOT_A_POE2_ITEM.title: Not a Path of Exile 2 item
NOT_A_POE2_ITEM.detail: Copy a Path of Exile 2 item first, then open the overlay again.

UNSUPPORTED_CLIPBOARD_LOCALE.title: Unsupported game client language
UNSUPPORTED_CLIPBOARD_LOCALE.detail: This version reads item text from an English game client only.

BASE_TYPE_UNRESOLVED.title: Base type not recognized
BASE_TYPE_UNRESOLVED.detail: The base type "{{text}}" could not be identified unambiguously from the crafting data.

ITEM_CLASS_UNRESOLVED.title: Item class not recognized
ITEM_CLASS_UNRESOLVED.detail: The item class "{{text}}" is not in the crafting data.

ITEM_LEVEL_MISSING.title: Item level missing
ITEM_LEVEL_MISSING.detail: The copied text has no item level.

AFFIX_UNRESOLVED.title: Modifier not recognized
AFFIX_UNRESOLVED.detail: "{{text}}" could not be matched to a known modifier.

AFFIX_AMBIGUOUS.title: Modifier matches several entries
AFFIX_AMBIGUOUS.detail: The copied modifier lines match more than one known modifier.

AFFIX_SIDE_UNKNOWN.title: Prefix or suffix unknown
AFFIX_SIDE_UNKNOWN.detail: It is unknown whether "{{text}}" is a prefix or a suffix. Advanced copy (Ctrl+Alt+C) shows this.

MARKER_UNCONFIRMED.title: Clipboard format not yet confirmed
MARKER_UNCONFIRMED.detail: The clipboard marker {{token}} has not been confirmed from a real game copy yet.

DESECRATED_STATE_UNDETERMINED.title: Existing Desecration cannot be ruled out
DESECRATED_STATE_UNDETERMINED.detail: The overlay cannot yet confirm from the copied text whether the item already has a Desecrated modifier.

MARK_UNRESOLVED.title: Mark state unclear
MARK_UNRESOLVED.detail: A modifier could be the Mark of the Abyssal Lord or another modifier with the same text pattern.

SPECIAL_ITEM_DETECTED.title: Special unique item
SPECIAL_ITEM_DETECTED.detail: {{name}} uses its own Desecration system, which is not supported yet.

TIME_LOST_JEWEL_DETECTED.title: Special Desecration rules
TIME_LOST_JEWEL_DETECTED.detail: {{baseItemName}} has separate Desecration outcomes, which are not supported yet.

NORMAL_COPY_LIMITED_DETAIL.title: Limited detail
NORMAL_COPY_LIMITED_DETAIL.detail: Normal copy has less modifier detail. Use advanced copy (Ctrl+Alt+C) for better results.

UNKNOWN_CURRENCY.title: Unknown currency
UNKNOWN_CURRENCY.detail: The selected currency is not in the crafting data.

UNKNOWN_OMEN.title: Unknown Omen
UNKNOWN_OMEN.detail: An active Omen is not in the crafting data.

PARSER_INSUFFICIENT.title: Item not identified
PARSER_INSUFFICIENT.detail: The item could not be identified well enough to evaluate the craft.

ITEM_NOT_RARE.title: Item is not Rare
ITEM_NOT_RARE.detail: {{currencyName}} can only be used on Rare items.

ITEM_ALREADY_DESECRATED.title: Item is already Desecrated
ITEM_ALREADY_DESECRATED.detail: The item already has a Desecrated modifier.

EXISTING_DESECRATION_UNDETERMINED.title: Existing Desecration not ruled out
EXISTING_DESECRATION_UNDETERMINED.detail: The overlay cannot yet confirm that the item has no Desecrated modifier, so it will not calculate a pool.

BONE_INCOMPATIBLE_ITEM_CLASS.title: Currency does not fit this item

ITEM_CLASS_TARGET_UNMAPPED.title: Item class not verified
ITEM_CLASS_TARGET_UNMAPPED.detail: It is not verified which currency can Desecrate {{itemClassName}}.

GNAWED_ITEM_LEVEL_TOO_HIGH.title: Item level too high
GNAWED_ITEM_LEVEL_TOO_HIGH.detail: {{currencyName}} only works on items of item level {{maxItemLevel}} or below.

LICH_OMEN_INCOMPATIBLE_WITH_BONE.title: Omen cannot be used with this currency

OMEN_INCOMPATIBLE_WITH_BONE.title: Omen cannot be used with this currency

ALTERED_COLLARBONE_LICH_OMEN_CONFLICT.title: Omen cannot be used with this currency

CONFLICTING_SIDE_OMENS.title: Conflicting side Omens
CONFLICTING_SIDE_OMENS.detail: Forcing both prefix and suffix at once is not supported.

UNKNOWN_MULTIPLE_LICH_OMENS.title: Several Lich Omens
UNKNOWN_MULTIPLE_LICH_OMENS.detail: Using more than one Lich Omen at once is not verified.

UNKNOWN_PUTREFACTION_OMEN_COMBINATION.title: Omen combination not verified
UNKNOWN_PUTREFACTION_OMEN_COMBINATION.detail: {{omenName}} together with side or Lich Omens is not verified.

UNKNOWN_PUTREFACTION_MARK_INTERACTION.title: Interaction not verified
UNKNOWN_PUTREFACTION_MARK_INTERACTION.detail: {{omenName}} on an item with the Mark of the Abyssal Lord is not verified.

UNKNOWN_ALTERED_PUTREFACTION_INTERACTION.title: Interaction not verified
UNKNOWN_ALTERED_PUTREFACTION_INTERACTION.detail: {{omenName}} with {{currencyName}} is not verified. The overlay will not guess the modifier pool.

UNSUPPORTED_SPECIAL_ITEM.title: Special item not supported
UNSUPPORTED_SPECIAL_ITEM.detail: This unique item uses its own Desecration system, which is not supported yet.

SPECIAL_JEWEL_RULE.title: Special rules not supported
SPECIAL_JEWEL_RULE.detail: {{baseItemName}} has separate Desecration outcomes, which are not supported yet.

RULE_EVIDENCE_MISSING.title: Rule not verified
RULE_EVIDENCE_MISSING.detail: A rule needed for this craft has no verified evidence.

AFFIX_LIMIT_UNKNOWN.title: Modifier limits not verified
AFFIX_LIMIT_UNKNOWN.detail: The maximum number of prefixes and suffixes for {{itemClassName}} is not verified.

AFFIX_CAPACITY_UNDETERMINED.title: Free modifier slots unknown
AFFIX_CAPACITY_UNDETERMINED.detail: Some modifiers could not be assigned to prefix or suffix, so free slots are unknown. Advanced copy (Ctrl+Alt+C) helps.

MARK_STATE_UNDETERMINED.title: Mark state unclear
MARK_STATE_UNDETERMINED.detail: It is unclear whether the item carries the Mark of the Abyssal Lord.

FRACTURED_STATE_UNDETERMINED.title: Fractured modifiers unknown
FRACTURED_STATE_UNDETERMINED.detail: It cannot yet be confirmed from the copied text which modifiers are fractured.

PARSER_PARTIAL_MOD_GROUPS.title: Blocking may be incomplete
PARSER_PARTIAL_MOD_GROUPS.detail: Some existing modifiers were not identified exactly; mod-group blocking may be incomplete.

UNKNOWN_MARK_SIDE_INTERACTION.title: Interaction not verified
UNKNOWN_MARK_SIDE_INTERACTION.detail: A side Omen for the side opposite the Mark of the Abyssal Lord is not verified. The overlay will not guess the modifier pool.

UNKNOWN_FRACTURED_MARK_INTERACTION.title: Interaction not verified
UNKNOWN_FRACTURED_MARK_INTERACTION.detail: Desecrating an item with a fractured Mark of the Abyssal Lord is not verified.

NO_REMOVABLE_AFFIX_ON_SIDE.title: No removable modifier
NO_REMOVABLE_AFFIX_ON_SIDE.detail: The target side is full and every modifier on it is fractured.

UNKNOWN_MIXED_CAPACITY_SIDE_CHOICE.title: Interaction not verified
UNKNOWN_MIXED_CAPACITY_SIDE_CHOICE.detail: With one side full and the other open, it is not verified which side Desecration uses. The overlay will not guess the modifier pool.

UNKNOWN_ANCIENT_MARK_FLOOR.title: Interaction not verified
UNKNOWN_ANCIENT_MARK_FLOOR.detail: {{currencyName}} on an item with the Mark of the Abyssal Lord combines two level floors in an unverified way.

MARK_REPLACED_FIRST.title: Mark is replaced first
MARK_REPLACED_FIRST.detail: The Mark of the Abyssal Lord is replaced by the new Desecrated modifier.

CONDITIONAL_TAGS_INCOMPLETE.title: Conditional pool may be incomplete
CONDITIONAL_TAGS_INCOMPLETE.detail: An unidentified modifier could change which modifiers can roll.

FORCED_LICH_POOL_EMPTY.title: Forced pool is empty
FORCED_LICH_POOL_EMPTY.detail: No modifier forced by {{omenName}} is possible on this item. The Omen is still consumed and the reveal offers regular modifiers.

ANCIENT_BENEFIT_OVERRIDDEN_BY_LICH_OMEN.title: Minimum level has no effect
ANCIENT_BENEFIT_OVERRIDDEN_BY_LICH_OMEN.detail: {{omenName}} overrides the minimum modifier level of {{currencyName}}.

MARK_FLOOR_OVERRIDDEN_BY_LICH_OMEN.title: Mark level floor has no effect
MARK_FLOOR_OVERRIDDEN_BY_LICH_OMEN.detail: {{omenName}} overrides the level floor of the Mark of the Abyssal Lord.

UNKNOWN_LICH_FALLBACK_COMPOSITION.title: Fallback pool not verified
UNKNOWN_LICH_FALLBACK_COMPOSITION.detail: Which modifiers the reveal offers when the forced pool is empty is not verified for this item. The overlay will not guess the modifier pool.

FAMILY_FLOOR_FALLBACK_TIER.title: Highest tier kept
FAMILY_FLOOR_FALLBACK_TIER.detail: No tier of this modifier reaches the minimum level, so the highest eligible tier stays in the pool.

EXCLUSIVE_OPTION_GUARANTEE_NOTE.title: Exclusive option offered
EXCLUSIVE_OPTION_GUARANTEE_NOTE.detail: When revealed, at least one option is an exclusive Desecrated modifier if one is possible.

ECHOES_REROLL_AVAILABLE.title: Reroll available
ECHOES_REROLL_AVAILABLE.detail: {{omenName}} lets you reroll the offered options once. The pool is unchanged.

ITEM_WILL_BE_CORRUPTED.title: Item will be corrupted
ITEM_WILL_BE_CORRUPTED.detail: {{omenName}} replaces the modifiers and corrupts the item.

ANCIENT_FLOOR_NOT_GUARANTEED_PUTREFACTIO.title: Minimum level not guaranteed
ANCIENT_FLOOR_NOT_GUARANTEED_PUTREFACTIO.detail: With {{omenName}}, {{currencyName}} does not make every new modifier meet the minimum level.

PUTREFACTION_SLOT_COUNT_WORKING_MODEL.title: Slot count is a working model
PUTREFACTION_SLOT_COUNT_WORKING_MODEL.detail: Up to {{maxUnrevealed}} Unrevealed modifiers, based on the verified modifier limits minus fractured modifiers.

WRONG_SIDE.title: Other side
WRONG_SIDE.detail: This modifier is on the other side.

MOD_GROUP_CONFLICT.title: Blocked by an existing modifier
MOD_GROUP_CONFLICT.detail: An existing modifier of the same group blocks it.

BASE_TAG_NOT_ELIGIBLE.title: Not possible on this base
BASE_TAG_NOT_ELIGIBLE.detail: This base type cannot roll this modifier.

SOURCE_NOT_ENABLED.title: Needs another currency
SOURCE_NOT_ENABLED.detail: This modifier needs a different Desecration currency.

LICH_SOURCE_NOT_SELECTED.title: Blocked by the active Omen
LICH_SOURCE_NOT_SELECTED.detail: The active Omen forces a different pool.

OTHER_LICH_BLOCKED_BY_FORCE_OMEN.title: Other Lich blocked
OTHER_LICH_BLOCKED_BY_FORCE_OMEN.detail: The active Omen blocks modifiers of other Liches.

LICH_CLASSIFICATION_UNDER_REVIEW.title: Classification under review
LICH_CLASSIFICATION_UNDER_REVIEW.detail: The data classifies this modifier inconsistently, so it is excluded from forced pools until reviewed.

PUTREFACTION_EXCLUDES_EXCLUSIVE.title: Not rolled by this Omen
PUTREFACTION_EXCLUDES_EXCLUSIVE.detail: This Omen never rolls Desecration-exclusive modifiers.

POSSIBLY_BLOCKED_BY_UNRESOLVED_AFFIX.title: May be blocked
POSSIBLY_BLOCKED_BY_UNRESOLVED_AFFIX.detail: An existing modifier that could not be identified exactly may block it.

BASE_POOL_ONLY.title: Base pool only
BASE_POOL_ONLY.detail: Pool for the base type and item level; current modifiers, Mark of the Abyssal Lord and Desecration state are not considered.
